spec.user_stories: - As a rider who has tapped an origin and destination, I press Find route and see step-by-step directions and a summary in the panel. - As a rider, I see only the rides of my trip highlighted on the map, with other lines hidden, so the trip is easy to read. - As a rider, I see a plain-language banner when the plan fails and can retry without Reset. - As a rider, I press Reset and get the full map and a clean panel back.
spec.acceptance_criteria: 1. Find route with 2 tapped points sends exactly one GET /api/plan with from_lat, from_lng, to_lat, to_lng (origin first) and no browser-side bbox check. Pass: one request observed with those four params. 2. Find route with fewer than 2 points shows banner "Incomplete origin and destination selection." and sends no request. 3. While pending: panel shows "Finding route…"; Find route and Reset are disabled; map taps and stop-dot taps do not add points. 4. After success Find route stays disabled until Reset. After a plan error or "No match found" Find route is enabled again and reuses the same two points. 5. Banner texts by error code: invalid_location "That location is outside the service area."; no_stop_nearby "No stops nearby."; no_route "No route found."; validation_error "The request wasn't valid. Please try again."; route_data_unavailable "No available routes."; internal_error "Something went wrong. Please try again."; fetch rejection "Network failure. Refresh the page and try again." The banner clears on Reset, on the next Find route, and 5 seconds after showing. 6. After any error all route lines and dots remain visible. 7. Panel order top to bottom: buttons, steps list, summary. 8. Steps list is one line per step: walk "Walk {distance_m} m to {to}"; ride "Ride {Color label} from {from} to {to} ({stops_passed} stops, {km} km)" with "1 stop" when 1; transfer "Transfer to {to_color label} at {from}" with walk_m appended in meters only when walk_m > 0 (exact wording pending clarification 5). Labels from COLORS (Yellow, Blue, Purple, Grey, Red, Dark yellow); direction never shown; "Your start point"/"Your destination" shown as returned. 9. Ride step lines have a background tint of the route color hex at alpha 0.50; text color inherited. 10. The API summary string is shown under the steps. 11. On page load, one global list is built from the already-fetched /api/routes and /api/routes/{id} data: per route record, line coordinates and each stop's name and position in order. No added requests. 12. For each ride step the route record is found by color and direction; step from/to are matched to stop names by exact string equality; if a name occurs more than once on the record, the pair with the shortest line stretch between them is used. 13. The highlighted portion runs between the line points nearest each of the two stops, drawn thicker in the route color. 14. All other lines are hidden. Only board and alight stop dots of each ride remain. Tap markers stay. Legend still shows all six. 15. If any ride is a wraparound (destination before origin in stop order) or cannot be matched, the panel shows "No match found" and nothing is hidden. 16. When a highlight is drawn, the map fits to the highlighted segments. 17. Reset restores all lines and dots, clears steps, summary, highlight, panel message and banner, returns to "pick origin", and re-enables Find route. 18. Changes limited to web/index.html, web/map.js, web/style.css. pytest output is reported as run; browser behavior is left to the owner's Verify list (including yellow/darkyellow tint readability).
spec.assumptions: - Only the owner-specified behavior; no other decisions made. Everything undecided is in the clarifications returned to the owner.
spec.edge_cases: - Reset during no pending request only (Reset is disabled while pending). - Plan with zero ride steps (walk only): no highlight to draw; behavior pending clarification 9. - Circular routes (yellow, purple, grey) list a shared stop twice (first and last). - Same stop name appearing in multiple route records; match is per record only. - Rapid double click on Find route.

risks.risk: The 5 second banner timer shares the single #banner element.
Matching by exact stop name and nearest-point slicing can misplace the highlight on loops or near-overlapping segments.
Tint at alpha 0.50 on yellow (#FACC15) with inherited dark text is fine, but darkyellow may be low contrast.

spec.dependencies: - GET /api/plan, /api/routes, /api/routes/{id} (existing). Leaflet vendored in web/. - Existing web/map.js handlers: setPoint, resetPoints, drawRoute, load, showBanner.
spec.self_critique: Every story maps to criteria. Criteria 8, 15, 17 depend on unresolved owner answers (clarifications 5, 9, 3). Biggest risk: the unstated panel/state model (no "pick origin" prompt or lock state exists in code).
